name: space
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background texture for a modern high-resolution vertical space shooter. Create a cinematic photorealistic deep-space environment with dark indigo depth, a vast luminous teal/violet nebula, subtle distant stars, wisps of volumetric dust, and small rocky debris at the extreme edges. Orthographic aerial view, no horizon, no perspective vanishing point. Rich realistic astronomical textures and physically plausible scattered light. Dark quiet centre for readable bright bullets and ships. Seamless-looking atmosphere suitable for slow scrolling. Full bleed, landscape 1536x1024 or larger, no ships, no characters, no HUD, no typography, no borders, no symbols.

name: verdant
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full-resolution gameplay scenery. Photorealistic cinematic aerial flight over an alien earthlike world: immense lush forested mountain ranges, turquoise river valleys and pale blue atmospheric haze; layers of realistic white cumulus clouds in the upper portion and distant landscape below. Oblique aerial camera aimed down 50 degrees, sweeping terrain below the pilot, central upper 60 percent quiet blue atmospheric negative space for bullet readability. Detailed rock strata, trees, sunlight scattering, realistic natural colour. Modern AAA space-shooter background plate, full bleed landscape 1536x1024 or larger, no craft or buildings or people, no text, no interface, no frame.

name: dunes
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full-resolution modern shooter background. Cinematic photorealistic alien desert viewed from a low-flying craft: sweeping intricately wind-carved red sandstone mesas and rolling amber dunes across the lower half, towering distant buttes under dusty apricot skies, thin cloud banks, warm sun through atmospheric haze. Oblique aerial camera down 50 degrees, upper half open subdued atmosphere for clear bright bullets. Real geology, fine sand ripples, physically plausible materials and light; a realistic game environment plate. Full bleed landscape 1536x1024 or larger. No aircraft, no people, no interface, no lettering, no frame.

name: frost
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: modern high-resolution shooter scenery. Cinematic photorealistic glacial alpine world below a flying craft, serrated snowy peaks and vast blue glaciers in the lower half, deep frozen fjords, distant mountains fading into luminous cold atmospheric haze, wispy white clouds and subtle pale aurora in a dark blue sky. Oblique aerial camera down 50 degrees. Quiet dark upper centre for readable action. Realistic snow microtexture, crevasses, blue ice, physically plausible sunlight, ambitious AAA rendering. Full bleed landscape 1536x1024 or larger. No ships, characters, buildings, UI, lettering or frame.

name: magma
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production cinematic game background. Photorealistic alien volcanic coastline from a low-flying craft: dark basalt terrain across the lower half with branching rivers of incandescent lava flowing into a black ocean, smoking volcanic cones in the distance, enormous ash-cloud layers under a dark crimson twilight sky. Realistic rock microdetail, glowing heat fissures, volumetric smoke, atmospheric perspective. Oblique aerial camera down 50 degrees, upper central half quiet dark haze for readable combat. Full bleed landscape 1536x1024 or larger. No craft, characters, buildings, HUD, text, symbols or frame.

name: cavern
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background texture for a modern photorealistic top-down shooter cavern level. Orthographic directly overhead close aerial view of vast dark grey layered basalt and rugged bedrock, tightly craggy ridges, fractured stone, crevices and tiny cool cyan mineral veins; low moody side lighting reveals realistic 3D rock surfaces, subtle amber geological glints, material-scanned realism. Full image filled edge to edge with rocky terrain; NO central tunnel or path cut into it, because the game will mask a moving corridor at runtime. Texture should look good as large scrolling stone walls. Landscape 1536x1024 or larger, no sky, ships, characters, text, border or interface.

name: sprites
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production game SPRITE ATLAS. A strict regular 4-by-4 grid of 16 isolated top-down spaceship/insect enemy sprites, each centred in its own equal square cell, identical orthographic camera, all noses/heads pointing UP, each whole object fully inside its cell with ample transparent padding. Genuine transparent background throughout, no grid lines, no labels, no shadows on a background. Modern photorealistic 3D-rendered sci-fi assets: brushed metal panels, micro-surface scratches, emissive engine cores, glass and organic iridescent chitin, realistic physically based lighting from upper left. Keep silhouettes crisp and clearly different at small sizes. ROW 1 left to right: elegant silver cyan player interceptor with swept wings; red twin-engine assault fighter; heavy angular orange gunship; circular violet alien scout. ROW 2: four biomechanical insect enemies: red scarab with antennae, emerald hornet with narrow wings, violet moth with broad translucent wings, amber wasp with long abdomen. ROW 3: mint-green angular prism fighter; cobalt shield bulwark with heavy broad armour; segmented orange mine-laying serpent; crimson narrow spearhead diving charger. ROW 4: purple crescent stealth phase-stalker; gold broad brood-carrier with twin drone bays; cyan annular orbital weaver with satellites; red-white long-rail sniper craft. Polished modern AAA look, detailed yet uncluttered. Square image 2048 by 2048 if possible. No text, UI, watermarks, baseplates, frames, checkerboard or scenery.

name: bosses
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production BOSS SPRITE ATLAS. Strict regular grid of 5 columns by 2 rows containing TEN isolated boss spacecraft, each centred with same scale and generous transparent padding in its equal rectangular cell. Direct overhead orthographic view, all fronts facing DOWN, physically based photorealistic detailed 3D renders: real metallic surface roughness, glass, machinery, energy engines and dramatic readable silhouettes. Genuine transparent background. ROW 1 left to right: red dreadnought with twin broad wings; violet orbital oracle with a core inside concentric rotating rings; industrial orange iron harvester with heavy paired claws; long blue arrowhead rift lancer; massive rectangular dark steel siege citadel with four corner turrets. ROW 2: rugged brown rocky cavern warden encrusted with stone; emerald broad-wing sky manta; amber scorpion with hooked pincers and a long curled tail; icy silver frost crown with five sharp spires; black and glowing red magma hydra with three separated mechanical heads. Each is a wholly different silhouette, whole body in cell, no overlap between cells. Landscape 2560 by 1536 if possible, no labels, no text, no background grid, no checkerboard, no UI, no frame, no drop shadows on a surface.

name: clouds
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production foreground CLOUD LAYER texture for a modern photorealistic aerial shooter. Genuine transparent background. Several widely separated thin wispy white clouds and soft fluffy cumulus clusters, viewed from above and slightly oblique, arranged only along the left and right edges of a wide landscape image; broad fully transparent open centre. Beautiful realistic volumetric sunlit cloud microdetail with subtly blue-grey undersides and fine translucent feathered edges. No blue sky, no ground, no horizon, no objects, no typography, no grid or checkerboard. The clouds will drift across mountainous game scenery in parallax. Landscape 1536x1024 or larger.

name: side_ship
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production player-ship sprite for the HORIZONTAL SIDE-SCROLLING stages of a cinematic sci-fi shooter. A single sleek futuristic starfighter seen in STRICT SIDE PROFILE, nose pointing RIGHT, engines at LEFT. A different ship from a top-down interceptor: elongated silver-white armoured fuselage, low swept dorsal fin, black-blue panoramic cockpit toward the right nose, twin cyan plasma engine nozzles at the far left, delicate orange navigation accents, subtle mechanically plausible panel lines, dark gun barrel projecting to the right. Physically based photorealistic 3D rendering with detailed brushed metal, light surface weathering, glass reflections, crisp silhouette, soft studio rim lighting. Entire ship fully inside the frame, centred with generous transparent margin. Genuine transparent background, no exhaust plume beyond short contained engine glows, no shadow on a surface, no scenery, no labels, no UI, no watermark. Landscape 1536x1024 image; the spacecraft itself is approximately three times wider than tall. Front is RIGHT, unmistakable clean side view, not a top-down or three-quarter view.
